calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fully_loaded = true
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  dp.sku,
  dp.product_name,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 5
  AND fsl.staff_purchase_flag = false
GROUP BY dp.sku, dp.product_name
ORDER BY SUM(fsl.quantity) DESC
LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  dp.sku,
  dp.product_name,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold,
  SUM(COALESCE(frl.quantity_returned, 0)) as units_returned,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) - SUM(COALESCE(frl.quantity_returned, 0)) as units_net
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 5
  AND fsl.staff_purchase_flag = false
GROUP BY dp.sku, dp.product_name
ORDER BY SUM(fsl.quantity) - SUM(COALESCE(frl.quantity_returned, 0)) DESC
LIMIT 10
